sources.notes: Authoritative for bonding-curve mechanics, automatic graduation and current fee schedule. Historical fee reconstruction still required by timestamp.
Strong feature taxonomy and bundle-level evidence, but universe contains only successfully migrated launches. Cannot serve as sole all-launch Killer Filter universe because of survivorship selection.

v1.4 corrigendum confirms effective observer visibility of only minutes due to top-50 newest buffer. 0.198% is a fast-window lower bound, not a 24h graduation rate. TIMEOUT cannot be used as clean 24h negative label.

Useful for repeated early-wallet structure. Real cohort association with buyer flow was weaker than activity-matched placebo lift, so repeated-wallet membership alone is not causal evidence and requires temporal construction plus launch-quality controls.

Reports robust first-five-minute classification on 6.4M Solana tokens and domain-shift effects across PumpFun/Raydium. Must independently reproduce labels, sampling and execution assumptions before treating as edge.
Large-scale pump.fun study identifies wash trading, creator address obfuscation, coordinated sells, copycats and social manipulation; motivates manipulation-specific controls in feature engineering.

Current docs recommend getTransactionsForAddress/getTransaction for new integrations; Enhanced Transactions remains available but is deprecated for new parser development. Need cost/rate-limit/coverage test before binding the lab.

blocking_questions: Which source can provide or reconstruct ALL launches with transaction-complete T+5m snapshots?
Can +24h outcomes be reconstructed independently from the same source without observer-window truncation?
Can creator/wallet history be computed strictly as-of each launch without future leakage?
Can historical fee, slippage and latency assumptions be timestamp-correct?
Can wallet clustering be built using only links known before each decision time?
